source.provider: Open Topo Data public API, serving NASA/USGS SRTM
source.nativeResolution: 3 arc-seconds, approximately 90 m at the equator
source.acquisitionEpoch: 11–22 February 2000; version 3 includes void filling from other elevation sources
source.interpolation: Open Topo Data bilinear interpolation; integer source raster may round interpolated values
source.license: Open scientific elevation data; NASA/USGS attribution retained. See product/provider documentation for source terms. No application-code license is asserted over these data. Open Topo Data service/software is separately operated.
limitations: Not a surveyed bare-earth digital terrain model: radar returns can include vegetation and buildings.
Historical surface observations and void-filled source data do not describe present-day construction.
The NightLens sampling grid is coarser than native raster postings and is only contextual terrain.
No per-sample uncertainty or original quality/void-fill flags are returned by this API.
Null values are retained as missing coverage/NODATA, not replaced by invented terrain.
Do not derive precise eye/platform heights or building foundation elevations from a roof-contaminated sample.
